newsitem.title: USA: Applied Materials wins $182 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Applied Materials wins $182 mln order.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc on Tuesday said it has won a $182 million order for semiconductor production systems from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co Ltd, based in Hsin Chu, Taiwan.

In a statement, Applied Materials said the majority of the order was booked in Applied Materials' fiscal 1997 second quarter ended April 27. Other portions were booked in the first and will be booked in the third quarter. Delivery will take place through the rest of fiscal 1997.
Taiwan Semiconductor is a leading service company for chip manufacturers and the largest semiconductor maker in Taiwan.
